Purpose and platform identity
HapIsabela facilitates job discovery and recruitment for Isabela City, Basilan, and other supported locations. It does not guarantee an interview, employment offer, or hiring outcome. Portal approval is moderation by HapIsabela; it is not government accreditation and does not establish that HapIsabela is a government employment agency.

Eligibility and registration
Use an account you are entitled to operate, provide an accurate email address, and follow the published eligibility rules. Eligibility and any age-related requirements require operator and legal confirmation. Public signup offers job seeker and employer roles only; administrator accounts require trusted provisioning. Employers must identify an authorized representative and complete verification before publishing vacancies.

Account security and responsibilities
Keep credentials confidential, use a strong password, and report suspected compromise through the confirmed support channel. You are responsible for information you submit to the best of your knowledge. Do not impersonate a person or organization, provide fabricated qualifications, share another person?s private documents without authority, or use unauthorized access methods.

Acceptable use and recruitment safety
Do not publish fraudulent, discriminatory, misleading, unlawful, harassing, or exploitative material. Do not solicit unlawful recruitment payments, bank passwords, or unnecessary sensitive information. Do not scrape private applicant records, sell applicant information, send unrelated marketing, bypass access restrictions, or interfere with the service. Report suspicious listings using the reporting form.

Employer responsibilities and vacancies
The Employer Responsibilities and Recruitment Policy forms part of employer onboarding. Describe duties, qualifications, location, work arrangement, compensation, deadlines, and required documents accurately. Approved employers submit vacancies for moderation. Material changes require renewed review. Overseas listings require applicable license and job-order verification; government listings must identify official sources. Portal approval never replaces independent official verification.

Applications and communications
Review the named employer, vacancy, selected documents, and sharing summary. A separate Job Application Agreement is required for each submission. Applicants must provide accurate information. Employers may assess authorized applications for legitimate recruitment purposes consistent with the applicable notices and lawful processing bases. Withdrawal preserves an appropriate submission and decision history; it does not silently erase a historical record.

Moderation, suspension, and termination
Authorized administrators may review, reject, request corrections, unpublish, close, or suspend content or accounts for documented policy or safety reasons. Decisions should have a reason and audit record. Use the complaints or privacy request process to raise concerns. Retention, appeal periods, and deletion criteria require confirmation and must not be invented.

Content and intellectual property
Submit only material you have the right to provide. Ownership remains with the appropriate rights holder. Any platform permission to host and transmit material must be limited to providing the disclosed service; exact licensing terms require legal review. Do not copy or misuse another person?s protected content.

Availability and liability
Network or provider failures can interrupt the service. Confirm submission using the application reference and dashboard; do not assume an interrupted request failed. Any limitations of responsibility must remain subject to applicable law and legal review. These draft terms do not waive rights that cannot lawfully be waived.

Changes and complaints
Published versions are retained. Material changes require appropriate notice and renewed acknowledgment where necessary. A Privacy Notice acknowledgment is not blanket consent for unrelated processing. Contact details, complaint handling targets, governing-law wording, dispute procedures, and effective date must be completed by the operator before publication.

privacy.content:
DRAFT ? NOT APPROVED FOR PRODUCTION

Controller and contacts
The actual operator, address, privacy contact or DPO, service contact, and request handling process must be confirmed before this notice is published. Admin or employer account details are not substitutes for the operator?s legal identity. Use the privacy request page for an access, correction, deletion, deactivation, or privacy concern request; identity must be verified before disclosing information or carrying out deletion.

Information collected
Accounts use name, email, role, contact information, account status, and authentication records. Job seeker records may contain general location, qualifications, education, skills, experience, preferences, portfolio information, CVs, and selected supporting documents. Employer records include business details, representatives, registration and recruitment verification information, and vacancy content. Applications store a submission snapshot, cover letter, chosen documents, reference, status history, interview and offer records, and application-specific acknowledgments. Do not submit unrelated sensitive information. Optional family or sensitive fields are excluded from the default recruitment snapshot.

Purposes and lawful processing bases
Processing supports account operation and security, employer verification, vacancy moderation, applications addressed to a named employer, recruitment communications, applicant tracking, dispute handling, and policy audit records. The operator must document the applicable lawful basis for each activity under the Philippine Data Privacy Act and relevant rules, including appropriate conditions for sensitive personal information. Do not assume every activity relies on consent. Terms acceptance and acknowledgment of this notice are distinct from specific consent where required.

Recipients and application sharing
The employer receiving an application may access its recruitment-related submission snapshot and selected documents. Unrelated employers cannot access it. Authorized administrators may access relevant application records for moderation and oversight; documents are opened on demand and are not public. New applications preserve their submission record even if the applicant later edits the profile. Legacy submissions without a snapshot are labelled accordingly. Data is not authorized for sale or unrelated marketing by the application agreement.

Providers, storage, and transfers
The implementation uses Supabase Authentication, PostgreSQL, and private Storage, with Vercel hosting and protected server functions. Confirm actual hosting regions, subprocessors, any email service, cross-border transfers and safeguards before publication. Do not claim certifications or storage locations without evidence. Access checks, private storage, short-lived authorized links, and audit records reduce risk but do not guarantee absolute security.

Retention and deletion
Specific retention periods, legal holds, deletion criteria, backup treatment, and disposal procedures are TO BE CONFIRMED by the operator and reviewed before publication. Preserve only records justified by the applicable purpose and lawful basis. A request to delete an account must be verified and assessed against legitimate retention obligations, not automatically treated as consent to erase audit evidence.

Rights and requests
Subject to applicable law and verification, you may request information, access, correction, objection, deletion or blocking, portability where applicable, and redress. The request page remains accessible without accepting new account terms. An authorized representative may need appropriate authority. The operator must provide an effective support/privacy contact and a documented response process. Individuals may raise concerns with the National Privacy Commission through its official channels; no specific outcome or deadline is promised in this draft.

Notifications and optional preferences
Essential service and security notifications are separate from optional alerts or promotional updates. Optional choices are unchecked by default and may be changed in preferences. Withdrawing an optional choice does not automatically prevent unrelated essential service access. Email delivery is not claimed until a configured provider accepts delivery.

Browser storage and cookies
Supabase maintains the authenticated session in browser storage. Saved jobs, alerts, and recruitment notifications use protected database records. The service worker stores an offline fallback rather than private account pages. A plain success message may survive a role redirect; passwords and account creation credentials are not saved in local or session storage. Confirm any analytics or third-party cookies actually deployed and explain their separate purposes before using them.

Updates
The notice has a unique published version, effective date, and retained historical content. Changes in processing require appropriate notice and specific consent where legally necessary; acknowledgment of this notice is not blanket permission for additional purposes.

By submitting this application, I request that HapIsabela transmit the application information and documents identified in my review screen to the named employer for assessment of my suitability for this vacancy.

I understand that the receiving employer may review the information for legitimate recruitment and selection purposes, subject to the applicable Privacy Notice and its own disclosed privacy practices.

I confirm that the details I submitted are accurate to the best of my knowledge.

I understand that submitting an application does not guarantee an interview, employment offer, or successful hiring.

Before each submission
Review the vacancy title, registered employer name, deadline, requirements, contact summary, cover letter, and exact filenames. Confirm that the details are accurate, that you understand the information and documents being shared, and that you agree to the current Job Application Agreement. Registration or a previous application does not acknowledge a new application.

Submission record
A successful submission preserves a reference, server submission time, the receiving employer and job, a recruitment-related profile snapshot, verified document references, and the specific immutable agreement and privacy versions acknowledged for that application. Failed uploads do not create a completed application. Repeated requests using the same submission key return the original record rather than creating duplicates.

Limited purpose and authorized access
The request is to share identified data for this vacancy and recruitment process. It does not authorize sale of applicant information or unrelated marketing. Only the applicant, appropriate receiving employer, and authorized administrators may access the related records under applicable safeguards. Optional family details and unrelated sensitive characteristics are not included in the default new application snapshot.

After submission
Review status updates, interview invitations, and offers in the dashboard. Eligible applications may be withdrawn while preserving an appropriate history. Contact the operator for verified data rights or correction requests concerning a historical submission. Retention periods and operator contacts must be confirmed before policy publication.

Authorized registration and verification
Register only a business you are authorized to represent. Provide the registered business name, address, contact information, representative, industry, business description, registration details, and relevant verification evidence. New employer accounts are pending verification. Portal approval is not official government accreditation and must not be presented as such. Material business changes may require renewed verification.

Truthful vacancy publication
Describe the actual role, responsibilities, qualifications, minimum education and experience, skills, salary range and period, location, workplace arrangement, openings, deadline, required documents, and recruitment instructions. Do not invent an affiliation, conceal unlawful fees, publish misleading compensation, or solicit unnecessary private data. Save drafts or submit vacancies for review; you cannot approve your own listings.

Overseas and government information
Identify whether an overseas listing is for an agency or direct employer, supply applicable license and job-order information, and independently verify through official channels. Portal administrators must record additional verification before approval. Government listings must identify the official source and requirements. Do not imply that HapIsabela approval confers a government license or accreditation.

Application access and purpose limitation
Access only applications submitted to your own vacancies. Use the recruitment-related snapshot and documents for the disclosed recruitment purpose. Do not sell, publicly post, scrape, disclose to unrelated recipients, or reuse application information for unrelated marketing. Protect downloaded records and comply with your own disclosed privacy practices and applicable lawful bases. Do not make employment decisions using irrelevant protected characteristics.

Selection and communications
Record review, shortlisting, rejection reasons, interview scheduling, results, offers, and hiring outcomes accurately. Respect withdrawals and communicate professionally. Online interview links must be secure HTTPS URLs, schedules must identify Philippine time, and changes or cancellations must be recorded. Do not misrepresent offers or require unlawful payments.

Safeguards and retention
Limit access to authorized representatives. Secure account credentials and recruitment exports, notify the operator of suspected misuse, and follow confirmed retention and disposal requirements. The operator and employer must confirm their respective controller/processor responsibilities; this draft does not invent a retention period or lawful basis.

Moderation and complaints
Administrators may request evidence, ask for corrections, reject, suspend, close, or unpublish unsafe or misleading material. Decisions should be documented and may be raised through the complaints process. Exact review standards, appeals, contacts, dates, and legal responsibility terms require operator confirmation and legal review.

Acknowledgment
The person registering the company confirms authority to act for it and acknowledges these responsibilities separately from the general Terms and Privacy Notice. Optional promotional permissions are not required for employer registration.
